IterationRecord.per_shape_ratios: WP14 C8 row-level ledger: this row's eval per-workload vs-ref ratios (same currency as the pricing table), for the harvest / cross-run layer to read row-wise beyond the digest's per_shape_best aggregation surface (per_shape_best_readings consumes the same family of fields) — the audit's plumbing-layer exclusion set covers trajectory.py's own aggregation consumption; whitelisted to prevent false positives.
IterationRecord.board_span_unstable: WP20 report-only: true when the paired protocol's reference-side mirror-pair spread exceeds 2x the kernel side (the reference side is the noisier one); the field name is a grep anchor WP20 reserved for the WP23 integration seam (CHANGES-WP20 section 50); semantics = a reference-side measurement-stability flag, unrelated to any external board or ranking; a same-source WARNING is also rendered next to the teacher's workload block.
EvalResult.precision_audit: WP20 accounting row (zero verdicts, written at benchkit.py:1906): the eval JSON declares the precision contract in force on this card; no driver read point is by design (the contract is made explicit for audit / human reading) and the row face is preserved via EvalResult.
EvalResult.stream_sentinel: WP20 sentinel reading (accounting only): a stream-span audit of the timed call; a violation is converted on the bench side into a fresh_recheck fail (mode=stream) that the driver consumes; the raw block is kept row-wise for audit reading — no independent driver reader of the reading itself is by design.
EvalResult.timer_integrity: WP20 sentinel reading (accounting only): clock/window identity re-parsing (ok|mismatch|unknown); a mismatch is converted on the bench side into a fresh_recheck fail (mode=timer) that the driver consumes; the raw block is kept row-wise for audit reading.
EvalResult.proc_census: WP20 sentinel reading (accounting only): a thread/child-process census after the timed region (ok|anomaly); an anomaly is converted on the bench side into a fresh_recheck fail that the driver consumes; the raw block is kept row-wise for audit reading.
